item.title: Franklin Templeton Joins Canton Network as Super Validator
item.summary: Franklin Templeton, a global asset manager overseeing more than $1.5 trillion in assets, has joined the Canton Network as a super validator, expanding its involvement in blockchain infrastructure and reinforcing its broader strategy for tokenized financial products.
